title: Colonization of Government Lands Sindh Amendment Act 1995

sections.shortTitle: Colonization of Government Lands Sindh Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1996
ACT IV OF 1996
COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Colonization
of Government Lands Act, 1912
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 1st February,
1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-25/95.----The
Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th December, 1995 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 29th
January, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement. ---(1) This Act may be called the
Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Colonization of Government Lands Sindh Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Amendment of sections 10 & 17 of Punjab Act V of 1912

ACT IV OF 1996
ACT IV OF 1996
COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Colonization
of Government Lands Act, 1912
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 1st February,
1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-25/95.----The
Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th December, 1995 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 29th
January, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of sections 10 & 17 of Punjab Act V of 1912.---In
the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912---
(i) in section 10 after
subsection (2), the following new subsection shall be inserted:---
"(2-A)
Notwithstanding anything contained in subsection (1) or subsection (2), such
land shall, not be exchangeable with private or kabuli land. "
(ii) in section 17, the full stop
at the end shall be replaced by a colon and thereafter, the following proviso
shall be added:---
"Provided
that such land shall not be exchangeable, with private or kabuli land".
